Disable a server for one profile or for all profiles

Usage: larp cc mcp disable [OPTIONS] <NAME> [PROFILE]

Arguments:
  <NAME>     
  [PROFILE]  

Options:
      --all                                    
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
